Blocks.Text: With this round of development, RT2 has gradually come closer to doing what I originally hoped it would do. Next, I will follow updates to the game, continue maintaining the existing features, and welcome and explore new ideas for performance optimization.

Further ahead, I would like to try connecting the prediction capabilities already in place and explore planning and solving an entire run around a seed: going beyond showing the outcomes of choices to helping players find ways to achieve their goals.

These explorations have no fixed timetable for now. I want RT2 to see further ahead while remaining easy to use. The effort of using new capabilities, the time spent waiting, and the cost of maintaining them will also shape whether I keep pursuing them.
